description: AGENTS.md-style notes for quayside, a fictional Python SDK, checked against the repository itself: pyproject.toml, Makefile, azure-pipelines.yml, client, error and model sources, CONTRIBUTING.md and CHANGELOG.md. Release 2.0.0 (2026-07-14) dropped Python 3.10, moved to httpx and changed how retries are counted, so several remembered facts are stale.
